results.content:
An Economist/YouGov poll conducted in August had similar findings. Like the Reuters/Ipsos poll, this one also found that Trump’s approval was 33% — “the smallest share to ever approve of Trump’s job handling in any Economist / YouGov Poll across both of Trump’s terms.” It also found him at a record-high 63% disapproval.

Republicans struggle to counter Democrats’ attacks on economy  August 19, 2026 / 10:41 [...] And that survey also showed Trump hemorrhaging die-hard followers. YouGov pointed out that Trump has “hit a new low for this term in the share of Americans who strongly approve of his job performance: 17%.” Its survey found that less than half of Republicans hold that view.
